user_query: What are the exact micro-F1 or macro-F1 scores achieved by LINE(1st+2nd) on the DBLP(AuthorCitation) network for the seven conference labels AAAI, CIKM, ICML, KDD, NIPS, SIGIR, and WWW?
llm_response: On the DBLP(AuthorCitation) network, LINE(1st+2nd) achieves the following F1 scores for the seven conference labels: AAAI 0.381, CIKM 0.356, ICML 0.401, KDD 0.430, NIPS 0.392, SIGIR 0.372, and WWW 0.418.
